Invoke 'chest_xray_expert' to confirm the presence of the pathology class (e.g., atelectasis) without relying on laterality.
2. Invoke 'chest_xray_report_generator' to check for specific mentions of laterality; if negative or ambiguous, proceed.
3. Invoke 'chest_xray_classifier' to verify elevated scores for the general pathology category (e.g., Atelectasis > 0.5) to justify further investigation.
4. Invoke 'xray_phrase_grounding' for each forced-choice option text (e.g., 'right lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis', 'left lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis').
5. Compare the bounding boxes returned by the grounding tool for each option.
6. Select the option whose grounded region corresponds to the expected anatomical location and visual opacity observed in the image.
7.
